# Pull Request Template

## Description
<!-- Describe the change you are proposing. Keep the scope focused and the description clear. -->

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug Fix (non-breaking change fix)
- [ ] New Feature (non-breaking change)
- [ ] Enhancement (improvement or re-factoring)
- [ ] Documentation Update
- [ ] Infrastructure Change

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code
- [ ] I have written appropriate documentation (if applicable)
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings
- [ ] Any dependent changes have been included (if applicable)

## Related Issues
<!-- Link to any related issues using GitHub usernames or issue numbers, e.g. Fixes #123 -->

- Related Issue: #<issue-number>

## Checklist for AI/Infrastructure Changes
- [ ] Tests pass locally
- [ ] Documentation updated (if user-facing)
- [ ] No breaking changes introduced (or documented)
- [ ] Security review completed (if applicable)
- [ ] Performance impact assessed (if applicable)
